shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md; find .agents -type f | head -50

sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 -i "table|data grid" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Table/hoc build/esm/components/Pagination 2>&1|head -40; cat build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 80,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -i "table|pagination|ThemeProvider" | head -20; cat tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/.bin | rg "^tsc$"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Pagination/types.d.ts; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -120; cat Table/hoc/index.d.ts; cat Table/index.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8
